title: Among male patients who first presented to the hospital after 1990 and have
question: Among male patients who first presented to the hospital after 1990 and have a normal white blood cell count, identify the top 5 distinct patients with the highest anti-Cardiolipin IgA antibody concentration who also have a creatinine level within the normal range. Return their IDs.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_058"
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'M'
  AND T1."XCL_062" > '1990-12-31'
  AND T2."XCL_030" BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0
  AND T2."XCL_056" IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(T2."XCL_056" AS REAL) BETWEEN 0.6 AND 1.2
ORDER BY T2."XCL_043" DESC
LIMIT 5
